steps.instruction: Leave the office and follow the corridor to the PANTRY sign.
steps.landmark: PANTRY sign above the counter on the left

steps.instruction: Continue along the corridor to the MEETING A sign beside the glass door.
steps.landmark: MEETING A sign beside the glass door

steps.instruction: Follow the corridor to the COPY ROOM sign on the right.
steps.landmark: COPY ROOM sign on the right-hand door

steps.instruction: Continue to the TOILETS sign. Stop outside the toilet entrance.
steps.landmark: TOILETS sign above the exterior toilet entrance
